Hi Aisha — great to meet you earlier.

Thanks for the W-9. To create the vendor master we need the following items from your side (minimal set):
• Legal name (exact as should appear on invoices)
• Tax ID / EIN (image or PDF of W-9 is acceptable)
• Registered business address and remit address (if different)
• Primary AP contact (name/email/phone) and a secondary contact
• Bank routing details for ACH (or a note if you want to be set up for wire only)
• Proof of incorporation or articles if the legal name on bank account differs from the invoice name
• Authorized signer name and title for contract signatures

I've attached our supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx — please complete and return. Once we have everything finance will kick off the master creation and provide a Vendor ID and default PO routing.

For terms: Marcus (cc'd) handles payment terms and will confirm whether Net30 can be offered or if PO cadence requires Net45 for the first 90 days.

Attachments: sunboard_onboarding_form.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

Office: +1 (415) 555-2400

Aisha / Kimberly — looping in finance context.

We can almost always support ACH. To finalize set-up please provide:
1) A bank letter or voided check that lists the account owner (matching legal entity)
2) Company EFT/ACH form with account and routing numbers (DocuSign link OK)
3) Confirmation of tax classification (C corp / S corp / LLC) — W-9 covers this but call-out helps

Regarding payment terms: standard on POs is Net45 for external hardware suppliers while we complete a short supplier risk review. If Sunboard can accept Net45 initially, we'll expedite the Vendor ID. After three on-time cycles we will convert to Net30. If Net30 is a hard requirement, let me know and I'll see what we can do for a pilot exception.

Please send the ACH doc to finance@redwoodinference.com or complete the DocuSign link I shared in the Redwood portal.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager — Payments

(comma included) while our operating name and W-9 show "Sunboard Inc" (no comma). Im attaching both so you can pick the canonical name that matches your vendor/master standards.

Attachments: sunboard_onboarding_form.xlsx, Articles_of_Incorporation_Sunboard.pdf, W-9_Sunboard.pdf

We can accept Net45 to start and would appreciate review for Net30 after the first few POs. I'll also complete the DocuSign ACH form today and send the bank letter as a separate email from our CFO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if Marissa needs any more corporate proofs for the legal record.

Best,
Aisha
